loginLead: Enter your home and your family.
signupLead: Then you will name the family and the first home.
goToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
passwordShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
emailInvalid: The email address is not valid.
authExists: An account with this address already exists.
authGeneric: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
twoFactorLead: Enter the code from your verification app.
createFamilyLead: The family is the shared space. The first home is created with it.
membersHidden: You cannot see the people in this family.
housesLead: Open a home or add one, within the plan limit.
houseLimitOne: This plan includes a single home.
houseLimit: This plan includes at most {count} homes.
accountLead: Name, language and theme stay on your account.
emailReadonly: The email address cannot be changed here.
homeLead: The home's deadlines are here: overdue, this week and this month. Open the rescue screen from here or from Personal. Home holds the house manual.
deadlinesLead: Dates already saved appear here. A maintenance task is added by hand, without a step-by-step guide.
deadlinesDoneHint: If you mark it done, it stays saved and leaves the open deadlines.
vaultBody: Family documents, encrypted on this device before they are saved.
personalBody: Cards for the people who live in this home: rescue, services and deadlines.
printBody: Prepare the sheet to hang at home and the compact rescue sheet.
printLead: Prepare the sheet to hang at home and the compact rescue sheet.
printUnavailable: Only someone who can edit the home prepares the sheets and sees the last reading.
printRevokeWarning: Sheets already hanging up will stop opening.
printCodeMissing: Prepare the codes before printing this sheet.
publicHouseLead: Shutoffs, tradespeople and the emergency contact of this home.
publicRescueLead: Rescue sheet for the people who respond.
publicRevoked: This code is no longer valid. Ask the family for a new sheet.
publicMissing: This code does not match a home.
extraBody: Reading log of the public codes of this home.
readingsLead: Each opening of a public code of this home appears here, newest first. Only the time, the kind of code and, when the browser sends one, a short device label are kept.
readingsLocked: The reading log is included in the Premium plan, including the thirty-day trial. On the Free, Basic and Advanced plans you can read this explanation, but not the list.
readingsHidden: Only someone who can edit the home sees the reading log.
guideFamilyBody: Each account can create one or more families. The first home is created with the family. If you belong to several families, open them from Family or from the switcher at the top.
guideHouseBody: The switcher at the top changes home and stays on the same section. In Home you fill in the guest manual, the water, gas, power and boiler cutoffs, the tradespeople, the utilities and the boiler-check deadline.
guideThemeBody: In Account choose light, dark or automatic. Automatic follows the device. Before sign-in the choice stays only on this device.
guideRestBody: The dashboard groups deadlines into overdue, this week and this month. The dashboard and Personal open the full-screen rescue view, with the cutoffs and the call to medical help. Personal holds rescue cards, services and, on the Premium plan, tax tasks. Vault keeps the encrypted documents. Print and code prepares the sheets to hang at home. In Extra, on the Premium plan or during the thirty-day trial, someone who can edit the home sees the reading log of the public codes.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Reload the page.
casaLead: Manual of the open home: what a guest needs, and where water, gas, power and the boiler are shut off.
casaPreviewLead: This is the guest view. Cutoffs and tradespeople stay hidden.
casaGuestHint: What you write here is visible to anyone with the guest view.
casaPhoneHint: With the international prefix, for example +39.
casaReadOnly: You can read these details, not change them.
casaPhoneInvalid: Write the number with the international prefix.
personaleNone: Nobody has been added in this home yet.
rescueEmptyPeople: No essential card has been filled in.
rescueHiddenCutoffs: The cutoffs are not visible with your role.
rescueHiddenPeople: The cards are not visible with your role.
personalePremium: Included in the Premium plan, and during the thirty-day trial.
personaleBankHintHelp: Only the last digits. The full account number is not written here.
personaleTaxEmpty: This year's list has not been prepared yet.
personaleReadOnly: You can read these details, not change them.
personaleHidden: This section is not visible with your role.
taxIncomeFirst: First instalment of personal income tax
taxIncomeSecond: Second instalment of personal income tax
taxSkipped: Does not apply to this person
vaultPlanLocked: The vault is included in the Advanced and Premium plans, including the thirty-day trial. With the current plan you can read this explanation, but you cannot enter documents.
vaultHidden: You cannot open this family's vault.
vaultLead: The server keeps only ciphertext. The code stays on this device.
vaultPhraseLead: Write these 24 words on paper and keep them. They are needed if you forget the code or change device. The application does not save them.
vaultPhraseMismatch: The words do not match. Check the phrase and try again.
vaultCodeHint: At least 6 characters. Avoid identical or sequential digits.
vaultCodeShort: The code must have at least 6 characters.
vaultCodeLong: The code can have at most 64 characters.
vaultCodeMismatch: The two codes do not match.
vaultCodeWrongLeft: The code is not correct. {count} attempts remain.
vaultCodeLocked: The code is locked. Set a new one with the recovery phrase.
vaultClosed: The vault is closed. Enter the code to continue.
vaultUnexpected: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
vaultUnreadable: This content cannot be read on this device.
vaultPhraseInvalid: The phrase is not valid. Check the 24 words.
vaultPhraseWrong: The recovery phrase does not belong to this account.
vaultPairLead: This device does not have the key yet. Enter the recovery phrase to continue.
vaultResetLead: The code is locked or you do not remember it. The recovery phrase sets a new one without weakening the protection.
vaultEmpty: No document yet. Add one by hand.
vaultReferenceHelp: Only a short reference, for example the last digits. Do not write the full number, codes or passwords.
vaultGoogleInactive: What was set on the inactive Google account
vaultKitLocation: Where the password recovery kit is kept
vaultNoGrant: This family's key has not been granted to your code yet.
vaultInvalid: Check the fields. Bank relationships cannot contain full numbers.
successionLead: Activities for the whole family. Fill them in by hand, without a step-by-step guide.
successionLocked: The succession checklist and the inheritance kit are included in Premium, including the thirty-day trial. With the current plan you can read this explanation, but you cannot edit the activities or print them.
successionHidden: You cannot open the succession checklist of this family.
successionNotesHelp: Write where the papers are or who to call. Do not write account numbers, codes or vault passwords: the inheritance kit must not contain them.
successionEmpty: No activities yet. Add the basic ones, or one of your own.
successionExport: Print or save the inheritance kit
successionSecret: Do not write a long number. The inheritance kit must not contain account numbers, codes or vault passwords.
successionKitNote: This sheet contains only the family checklist. It does not contain the vault documents.
successionFamilyBody: Activities to keep ready, and an inheritance kit to print. Premium and the thirty-day trial can edit and print them.
guideSuccessionBody: The family holds the succession checklist: papers, will, notary, property titles, the declaration within twelve months and utility transfers. With Premium, or during the trial, you mark them by hand and print the inheritance kit. The sheet does not contain the vault documents.
hostMarkLead: The name, colour, welcome sentence and a small logo appear on the wall sheet, the rescue sheet and the pages opened by the codes.
hostMarkPlan: Premium and the thirty-day trial can change it.
hostMarkFree: Free and Basic keep the DomuSafe mark on printed sheets.
hostMarkAdvanced: Advanced shows no DomuSafe mark and has no mark of its own.
hostWelcomeLong: The welcome sentence is too long.
hostLogoHint: A very small picture. A large one is not saved.
hostLogoTooBig: The picture is too large. Choose a smaller one.
hostTwoFactor: If you sign in with a password, saving requires the two-step check.
guideHostBody: In Account, an administrator on Premium or during the thirty-day trial can choose a name, a colour, a welcome sentence and a small logo. They appear on the sheets and on the public pages. Free and Basic keep the DomuSafe mark on the sheets. Advanced shows neither that mark nor a mark of its own.
